title: 比較
description: 比較事物差異的表達方式

sentences.en: Compared to last year, our sales have doubled.
sentences.zh: 與去年相比，我們的銷售額翻了一倍。

sentences.en: This option is better than the previous one.
sentences.zh: 這個選項比前一個更好。

sentences.en: The two products are similar to each other in design.
sentences.zh: 這兩個產品在設計上相似。

sentences.en: The difference is that this version is more efficient.
sentences.zh: 區別在於這個版本更有效率。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the second plan is less expensive.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，第二個計畫花費較少。

sentences.en: Unlike the old system, the new one is fully automated.
sentences.zh: 與舊系統不同，新系統完全自動化。

sentences.en: In contrast to popular belief, the data shows otherwise.
sentences.zh: 與普遍看法相反，數據顯示的情況不同。

sentences.en: This method is far superior to the traditional approach.
sentences.zh: 這種方法遠優於傳統做法。

sentences.en: Both options have their advantages and disadvantages.
sentences.zh: 兩個選項都有各自的優缺點。

sentences.en: The more you practice, the better you become.
sentences.zh: 你練習得越多，就變得越好。

sentences.en: While Plan A is faster, Plan B is more cost-effective.
sentences.zh: 雖然方案A更快，但方案B更具成本效益。

sentences.en: There's a significant gap between theory and practice.
sentences.zh: 理論與實踐之間存在顯著差距。

sentences.en: This is by far the most challenging project we've had.
sentences.zh: 這是我們迄今為止最具挑戰性的專案。

sentences.en: The situation is not as bad as it seems.
sentences.zh: 情況沒有看起來那麼糟。

sentences.en: Similarly, the other team faced the same challenges.
sentences.zh: 同樣地，另一個團隊也面臨相同的挑戰。

sentences.en: Whereas the first model is compact, the second is portable.
sentences.zh: 第一個型號小巧，而第二個則是便攜式的。

sentences.en: The main distinction between them is the price point.
sentences.zh: 它們之間的主要區別是價格定位。

sentences.en: This software is just as reliable as the competitor's.
sentences.zh: 這款軟體和競爭對手的一樣可靠。

sentences.en: In comparison with other cities, this one is quite affordable.
sentences.zh: 與其他城市相比，這座城市相當實惠。

sentences.en: The new policy is slightly different from the old one.
sentences.zh: 新政策與舊政策略有不同。

sentences.en: One major similarity is that both require teamwork.
sentences.zh: 一個主要的相似之處是兩者都需要團隊合作。

sentences.en: On one hand it's risky, but on the other it's rewarding.
sentences.zh: 一方面有風險，但另一方面回報很高。

sentences.en: The gap between the two candidates is narrowing.
sentences.zh: 兩位候選人之間的差距正在縮小。

sentences.en: This is nowhere near as difficult as I expected.
sentences.zh: 這遠沒有我預期的那麼困難。

sentences.en: Likewise, the second experiment produced similar results.
sentences.zh: 同樣地，第二次實驗產生了類似的結果。

sentences.en: The advantage of this approach over others is its simplicity.
sentences.zh: 這種方法相比其他方法的優勢在於其簡單性。

sentences.en: There's no comparison between handmade and mass-produced goods.
sentences.zh: 手工製品和量產商品無法相比。

sentences.en: As opposed to working alone, collaboration yields better results.
sentences.zh: 與獨自工作相反，合作能產生更好的結果。

sentences.en: The former is more practical, while the latter is more creative.
sentences.zh: 前者更實用，而後者更有創意。

sentences.en: All things considered, option A is the stronger choice.
sentences.zh: 綜合考慮，選項A是更有力的選擇。
